brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished a Palestinian home and filled a water well in the Bani Naim–Yatta desert area south of Hebron on Tuesday, IMEMC News reported. The operation targeted structures in a region where Palestinians depend on limited water resources for survival.

The demolition marked the latest in a series of operations across Palestinian communities in the southern occupied West Bank. Israeli authorities have intensified such actions in recent months, affecting multiple villages and towns in the area. Local activists have been documenting the demolitions as families lose homes and infrastructure to the operations.
